Only one feasible point exists: E001/A1a at 0.7549, 7.22 s. Two neutral perturbations (E004, E011) both landed lower, around 0.752-0.753, so even that baseline is probably a lucky draw. Most verdicts after it rest on single 3-seed runs whose differences are within the ~0.25 pp perturbation noise.

**Contradicted or invalid conclusions**
- **H2.5:** the random-resized-crop confound is moot. E006 never used random-resized crop, so E014 tested only 24 px against 26 px.
- **"32 px share drives accuracy":** the data contradict it. E013 put 1.8x more epochs at 32 px than E006 and gained only +0.26 pp. E006 is just 0.22 pp behind 8 full-res epochs while costing 0.92 s less. That points to total epochs mattering more than resolution share, and no hypothesis node says so.
- **Suspicious seed spread:** E006's 0.02 pp spread across seeds suggests the augmentation streams may be shared. H2.1.3 is unresolved.

**The obvious next step, never run**
The cost curve shows 28 px is poor value (79% of a full-res epoch's cost) while 24 px costs 57%. Yet E013, E014 and E016 all spent their budget on 26/28 px, and the notebook's own 24 -> 32 two-stage follow-ups (9.5-10 epochs, ~6.3-6.6 s) were never tried.

**Other untested directions**
- Smaller batch size: the energy-bound model predicts it is time-neutral, and E010 suggests it would help accuracy.
- Resolutions below 24 px.
- Narrowing the high-resolution groups (H2.6).
- BN recalibration (H6.2).
- Cheaper GELU variants (tanh approximation).
- Muon (H5), which sits at 0.65 confidence with zero runs.

**Tree hygiene**
- Several parents remain 'open' after their only child was refuted: H1.4, H2.3, H3.1, H3.3, H6.1, and H3 overall.
- H1.5.1 is effectively supported by E007 but has no evidence attached.
- The epoch slope (~1 pp/epoch) comes from a single noisy difference, and every exchange rate in the notebook inherits that uncertainty.
- Accuracy prediction bands are too wide to be informative.
- Fixed-seed selection near the threshold needs extra-seed confirmation before any new tip is declared.
